rows.en: Finishing you off right here would be easy, but I'll hold off for a little while.
My rowdy underlings have more power than they can handle, and they're itching to cut loose...
So I've prepared a fun little game that uses this entire Cube.
Win your way through this game and make it to me, and I'll take you on again.
The heroes collapsed where they stood and lost consciousness...
You think you can stand up to Regis with that little power? Don't make me laugh!!
Even Taro gave me more of a fight than that!!

That's right. He gave me plenty of trouble, but now he's frozen solid deep inside the Plasma Tower!!
Now then, I've got the Plasma Spark, so it's time I said goodbye to this Cube.
All that's left is to revive the lot in the Monster Graveyard and create the Belial Army!!
Finishing you off right here would be easy, but I'll hold off for a little while.

How much time had passed...? When they came to, they were back at the base.
You were found collapsed and rescued by Jack and Ace, who had gone out searching.

notes.note: Continues the grunt/silence pairs from story_067 (#0.55-0.62). Per 0403.bla Pt_Chara_Check order (15,14,12,11 then 5,4,2,1,3,6,7,9,10) the Ultra-leader pairs are Zero, Mebius, Seven, Ultraman, so #0.60 = Seven's silence, #0.61-0.62 = Ultraman.

Extractor labels this Ultraman Belial, but Belial has just exited (Chara_Out) and the line is the leader-slot hero calling after him. #0.68-0.71 = Zero, Mebius, Seven, Ultraman variants; #0.122-0.130 = the nine non-Ultra leaders. Identical Japanese, identical English.
#0.80-0.119 are the non-Ultra-leader version of the Belial scene (Belial lines duplicated without speaker labels). Speaker of #0.80-0.82, #0.92-0.96, #0.116-0.119 is Ultraman Belial.

#0.83-0.91 = OOO, W (Shotaro), RX, Rider 1, Den-O (Momotaros), Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00 per the second Pt_Chara_Check run. These heroes don't know Taro, so 'that' instead of a gendered pronoun. #0.84 (rough 'that guy') fits Shotaro. #0.85-0.91 end without a question mark, so rendered as a musing statement.

Source says 'Plasma Tower' here (the Ultra-leader version #0.49 says Plasma Spark Tower, and 'inside' instead of 'deep inside'). Kept literal; normalise to 'Plasma Spark Tower' if preferred. Belial knows Taro, so 'he' (glossary g=m).
Kaiju Graveyard = 'Monster Graveyard' (official English, Ultra Galaxy). Belial Army (Belial Gun-dan). Neither is in the glossary.
Giga Battlenizer: official English for Belial's staff; kept the source brackets as quotes.
Grunt/silence pairs #0.98-0.115 for the nine non-Ultra leaders in the order OOO, Shotaro, RX, Rider 1, Momotaros, Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00; source has no punctuation, '!' added as a cut-off grunt.
Speaker not recovered; likely Zoffy or Hikari at the base (story_069 continues with the rescuers Jack/Ace). Subject 'you' restored.
#0.138-0.150: 13 leader variants, all identical. The line deliberately trails off while the speaker tries to remember.
Speaker not recovered (same base speaker as #0.137). No pronoun needed for the unseen speaker.

report: All 80 rows translated. Variant order from 0403.bla Pt_Chara_Check runs. #0.68 is mislabelled Belial by the extractor (it is a hero's 'W-wait...'). #0.92 keeps the source's 'Plasma Tower' (elsewhere Plasma Spark Tower). #0.137/#0.151 speaker not recovered. Not in glossary: Plasma Spark, Plasma Spark Tower, Monster Graveyard, Belial Army, Giga Battlenizer.
